column1: # Stage S6 P6 — line of sight over the elevation model, inside one building and through the streamed world becomes the terrain_line_of_sight, interior_line_of_sight and world_line_of_sight crates. Paths name the tree before the move; the GPU upload of the viewshed (`los/terrain/overlay.rs`) stays in the map engine.
# the elevation profile, the radial march, the viewshed and its sliced job become terrain_line_of_sight,
# each file named after what it computes
# the compound walk and the floor wash become interior_line_of_sight
# the world occluder, its box trees, chunk walk, queries and prefab occluder library become
# world_line_of_sight; the two halves of the query file and the descriptor folder take names that
# the moved terrain code names its own items from its crate root and the elevation model from its crate
# the moved interior code names its own items from its crate root, the viewshed vocabulary from
# terrain_line_of_sight, the meshes from spatial_indexes and the building model from building_interiors
# the moved world code names its own items from its crate root, the compound walk from
# interior_line_of_sight, and the meshes, chunks, catalogue rows and building model from their crates
